_note: Ranger (2024), a half caster. Reconstructed from shipped generated data to restore the build source of truth.

classes.name: Ranger
startingEquipment: Studded Leather, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Druidic Focus, Explorer's Pack, 7 GP
classes.flavor: A wilderness warrior and hunter who blends martial skill, primal magic, and a relentless mark that hounds a chosen quarry.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Ranger spells using Wisdom, preparing a growing list (shown on the table) from the full Ranger list; you have no cantrips. Save DC is 8 + Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus. You can use a Druidic Focus.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You always have the Hunter's Mark spell prepared, and you can cast it without a spell slot a number of times per Long Rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the Mastery property of two kinds of weapon you're proficient with. You can change your choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.description: You gain Expertise in one skill you're proficient in and learn two languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat (Archery, Defense, Druidic Warrior, or Two-Weapon Fighting are common).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Roving
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and you gain a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skill proficiencies to gain Expertise (double proficiency).

features.name: Tireless
features.description: As a Magic action you can give yourself Temporary HP (roll 1d8 + Wisdom modifier), a number of times per Long Rest equal to your proficiency bonus, and finishing a Short Rest reduces your Exhaustion level by 1.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can become Invisible until the end of your next turn, a number of times per Long Rest equal to your proficiency bonus (or by expending a spell slot).

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: You gain Blindsight with a range of 30 feet, letting you sense creatures you can't see nearby, and you always know the direction to your Hunter's Mark target.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 8th, 12th, and 16th level.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Dimensional Travel is a fitting choice.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: Your Hunter's Mark damage die becomes a d10, and once per turn you can add your Wisdom modifier to an attack roll or damage roll against your marked target.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.flavor: A monster-slayer trained to fell the great threats to civilization — whether a lone giant or a swarming horde.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: You gain Hunter's Lore (learn a marked creature's damage immunities/resistances/vulnerabilities). Choose Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer (once per turn, +1d8 damage to a creature below its HP maximum) or Horde Breaker (once per turn, a second attack against a different creature within 5 feet of the first).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage) or Multiattack Defense (after a creature hits you, it has Disadvantage on further attacks against you this turn).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.description: When you damage your Hunter's Mark target, you can also deal the Hunter's Mark bonus damage to one other creature nearby.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: When you take damage, you can use a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage (and to that damage type until the start of your next turn).

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.flavor: A ranger bonded to a primal companion that fights at their side, growing fiercer as the bond deepens.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: You magically summon a Primal Beast companion (Land, Sea, or Sky) that obeys you, shares your proficiency bonus, and acts on your turn — taking the Attack action when you command it as a Bonus Action. If it drops, you can revive it or resummon it after a rest.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: On your turn you can command your companion to take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action as a Bonus Action, and its attacks deal Force damage if you wish.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: Your companion makes two attacks when it takes the Attack action, and once per turn it can add your Hunter's Mark bonus damage.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your companion if it's within 30 feet.

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.flavor: A ranger touched by the Feywild — uncanny charm, dread magical strikes, and fey allies that appear at need.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: You gain Fey Wanderer spells and Otherworldly Glamour (add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks, and proficiency in a Charisma skill). Once per turn, your weapon hits deal extra Psychic damage.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.description: You have Advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened, and when a creature near you succeeds on a save against those conditions, you can use a Reaction to redirect the effect onto another creature.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: You always have Summon Fey prepared and can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest, and the summoned fey can turn Invisible.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: You can cast Misty Step without a spell slot a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Wisdom modifier, and you can bring a willing creature with you.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.flavor: An ambusher of the dark places of the world, striking first and hardest and vanishing into shadow.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: You gain Gloom Stalker spells and Umbral Sight (Darkvision, and you're invisible to creatures relying on Darkvision to see you). On your first turn of combat your Speed increases and you make an extra weapon attack that deals bonus Psychic damage, and you add your Wisdom modifier to your Initiative.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or another mental save if you already have it).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Once per turn when you miss with an attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: When a creature attacks you and doesn't have Advantage, you can use a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the roll and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
